newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 6,822 to dollar for Feb 14-16 BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 6,822 to dollar for Feb 14-16 BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 6,822 to the dollar for February 14 to 16.
The reference rate set on Wednesday is a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Tuesday for February 13 is 6,725 to the dollar. It was 6,464 on Wednesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
